name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
short: Over-ear Bluetooth headphones with deep bass and 30 hours of battery.
description: Comfortable over-ear headphones tuned for rich bass and clear vocals. The soft memory-foam ear cushions and adjustable headband make long listening sessions easy, and the built-in microphone lets you take calls without reaching for your phone. A single charge gives up to 30 hours of playback, and a wired audio cable is included for backup.

specs.In the box: Headphones, USB-C cable, AUX cable, pouch

name: Classic Analog Wrist Watch
short: Minimal stainless steel watch with a genuine leather strap.
description: A clean, minimal analog watch that suits both office and casual wear. The stainless steel case is paired with a genuine leather strap and a scratch-resistant glass face. Quartz movement keeps accurate time, and the watch is splash resistant for everyday use.

name: Everyday Laptop Backpack 25L
short: Water-resistant 25L backpack with a padded laptop compartment.
description: A practical 25 litre backpack for work, college and short trips. The padded compartment fits laptops up to 15.6 inches, and the water-resistant fabric protects your things in light rain. Multiple pockets keep chargers, bottles and documents organised, while padded straps spread the weight comfortably.
features: Padded shoulder straps and back panel

name: UV Protection Polarized Sunglasses
short: Lightweight polarized sunglasses with 100% UV protection.
description: Lightweight sunglasses with polarized lenses that cut glare and block harmful UV rays. The flexible frame is comfortable for all-day wear and works well for driving, travel and outdoor activities. A protective case and cleaning cloth are included.

name: Insulated Steel Water Bottle 750ml
short: Double-wall insulated bottle keeps drinks cold 24h and hot 12h.
description: A durable stainless steel bottle with double-wall vacuum insulation that keeps water cold for up to 24 hours and hot drinks warm for up to 12 hours. The leak-proof lid and powder-coated body make it ideal for the gym, office or travel.
features: Keeps cold for 24 hours, hot for 12 hours

name: Slim Wireless Keyboard
short: Slim wireless keyboard with quiet keys, works with all devices.
description: A slim, quiet keyboard that connects over Bluetooth to laptops, tablets and phones and can switch between devices. Low-profile keys feel comfortable for long typing sessions, and a rechargeable battery lasts for weeks on a single charge.
features: Bluetooth connection to up to 3 devices
Works with Windows, macOS, Android and iOS

name: Matte Ceramic Coffee Mug
short: 350ml matte ceramic mug, microwave and dishwasher safe.
description: A sturdy 350 ml ceramic mug with a smooth matte finish and a comfortable handle. It holds heat well, is safe for both the microwave and the dishwasher, and looks good on any desk or kitchen shelf.

name: Combed Cotton Crew T-Shirt
short: Soft 100% combed cotton t-shirt with a relaxed everyday fit.
description: A soft, breathable t-shirt made from 100% combed cotton. The relaxed regular fit and reinforced stitching keep it comfortable and long lasting through repeated washes, making it an easy everyday basic.

specs.Care: Machine wash cold, do not bleach

name: Lightweight Running Shoes
short: Breathable lightweight running shoes with cushioned soles.
description: Lightweight running shoes with a breathable mesh upper and a cushioned midsole that absorbs impact on every stride. The grippy outsole holds well on roads and tracks, making these suitable for daily runs, walks and gym sessions.

name: 10000mAh Fast Charging Power Bank
short: Slim 10000mAh power bank with 20W fast charging.
description: A slim, pocket-friendly power bank with 10000mAh capacity and 20W fast charging over USB-C. Two output ports let you charge two devices together, and built-in protections guard against overcharging and overheating.
